purpose: Independently evaluate whether a proposed capability-state transition is justified by a closed, required evidence domain.
completeness_rule: All required evidence classes and required source IDs must be present, uniquely identified, and internally linked. Absence is INCOMPLETE; mutually inconsistent evidence is CONTRADICTORY.
integrity_rule: Every evidence object must have a content_digest and the witness must recompute it from canonical content.
transition_rule: ACCEPT only when all required evidence is present and internally consistent and the proposed transition is exactly the transition declared by this experiment.
blindness_rule: The witness MUST ignore any supplied Reality verdict, confidence, reasoning, authority flags, or capability-status assertion when deciding.
independence_rule: Witness rules and contract are external to Reality's runtime and are not accepted as evidence merely because Reality declares them valid.
mutation_rule: The witness has no authority to modify Reality, authorize Reality, execute external actions, or alter the experiment contract.
